headline_cn: 源经验生成的策略在 8 个新几何任务上全通过；同一动作先验加普通 GP 也为 8/8，尚未建立独特的新机制。

source_acquisition.source_gp_uses: All unique actions from all source records; source-only likelihood calibration.

interpretation: There is a useful executable source-experience transfer signal in this development sample. The unchanged generated policy wins all eight targets and uses 37 queries. However, seven already succeed without history, removing contact-event labels changes no proposal or trajectory, and ordinary GP with the identical source-derived proposal prior also wins all eight in 45 queries. These observations do not establish a distinct new experimental learning mechanism.
causal_boundary: The no-outcome mask retains attempted actions, invalid flags and attempt count; the prior-only arm supplies empty history, so it also removes the attempt schedule. Their 6/8 versus 7/8 difference must not be interpreted as an isolated score-feedback effect. Ablations and prior-matched controls were specified after observing the original results and reuse the same eight development targets.
mechanism: Source-authored code contains geometry-relative large-ball proposals, score-thresholded local Gaussian perturbations, approximate collision rejection and a parcel contact branch. The branch is unnecessary on observed targets. This is an implemented program, not a new estimator established by naming it.
limitations: Two native families and four target seeds each; one optimizer seed and one authored program per condition.
World laws remain fixed; new scene geometry is not changed-law transfer.
No faithful HExA or Causal-PIK reproduction and no ICLR-scale evaluation.
The no-experience program has 74 invalid proposals; both programs conservatively treat the randomly initialized red placeholder as an obstacle. Outputs were evaluated unchanged.
Model prompting and source-summary selection are part of the method; no causal isolation of all summary or prompt choices.
37 versus 45 queries is a small development difference, not established statistical superiority.

native_replay.scope: Replay of all eight generated-policy successes through native env.step; verification only, not eight additional independent tasks.

native_verification.scope: Replay of all eight generated-policy successes through native env.step; verification only, not eight additional independent tasks.

decision: Retain the source-prior capability and all successful records; do not claim novel event-feedback learning or scale up yet.
next_requirement: Keep the demonstrated source-derived geometry prior as a working baseline. A new method must identify and test a learning operation beyond ordinary experience-to-code generation plus prior-guided continuous optimization; isolate its causal contribution against the identical prior with ordinary optimizers and applicable HExA/Causal-PIK methods. The current two task families vary geometry, not world laws. Independent seeds/model generations and changed-mechanism/core-task evidence are required before broad novelty claims or long GPU work.
